script.instructions: Speak Russian. Male cartoon duck show host: bright medium-high nasal quacky timbre, energetic theatrical comic confidence. CLEAR natural lateral lisp on Russian с з ш ж sounds, slightly wet whistling consonants, but every word intelligible. Brisk and animated, never a calm audiobook narrator. Original cartoon duck character voice. Lateral duck lisp should be obvious and consistent, but every word clear. Brisk confident game-show host, comedic and animated, no screaming. Read only the input verbatim, with complete first/last syllables. No extras or effects. Read each paragraph exactly once as a separate complete line. Keep the same voice. Leave TWO SECONDS OF SILENCE between paragraphs. Within each paragraph speak briskly and continuously, without dramatic pauses or drawn-out vowels. Never repeat a take. No extra words, music or effects. Short silence before first and after last line.

clips.text: Прикинь: на конец лески можно вешать разные предметы! Не веришь? Загляни в список предметов в инструкции.

clips.text: Ну и ну. От тебя столько же тишины, сколько от петард в больничной зоне. Чтобы красться тихо, используй кнопку скрытности. А теперь отойди за черту, если хочешь попробовать снова.
